questions.prompt: What does Burrow discover when his new tunnel falls open?
choices: He tumbles into a large old room.
He reaches the bottom of the Crystal Stream.
He finds a tunnel that Flint has just mapped.
questions.answer: He tumbles into a large old room.
questions.evidenceText:
He tumbled into a room.
It was large.
It was old.
It was not a tunnel.

questions.prompt: What clearly shows that Luna remembers the hidden room?
choices: She says she was there a very long time ago.
She says Burrow built the room that morning.
She says the ceiling stones are a new spell.
questions.answer: She says she was there a very long time ago.
questions.rationale: The narration says Luna had been in the room before, and Luna answers yes before saying it was a very long time ago; her own memory clearly shows she remembers the hidden room.
questions.evidenceText:
"Yes," said Luna.
She looked around the room.
"A very long time ago."

supportingEvidence.evidenceText:
She touched the carvings.
They lit up where she touched.
Blue and gold.
She had been here before.

questions.prompt: Why is the Memory Room important to Moonwood?
choices: A community should remember its oldest stories.
The room was built to guide Burrow's newest tunnel.
The carvings showed only Luna's own memories.
questions.answer: A community should remember its oldest stories.
questions.rationale: Luna says the Memory Room keeps Moonwood's oldest stories, then tells one while Burrow listens; preserving and sharing these stories shows why a community should remember its oldest stories.
questions.evidenceText:
"This is the Memory Room," said Luna.
"This is where Moonwood keeps its oldest stories."

supportingEvidence.evidenceText:
Burrow sat very still and listened.
The room grew warmer.
The carvings lit up one by one.
Luna's voice was quiet and certain.
